lesson.title: Help! It's raining stuff!
lesson.text: Things are dropping from the sky! Slide your basket to catch them all. Watch the yellow numbers: they get faster and faster as things fall!

quiz.question: Pip's speed meter said 9.8 after 1 second and 19.6 after 2 seconds. What will it say after 3 seconds?
quiz.explanation: The sky adds 9.8 every second! 9.8 + 9.8 + 9.8 = 29.4. The longer something falls, the faster it goes. That's gravity!
